migration_steps.activity: Establish PQC migration programme governance: appoint programme lead, define RACI, secure executive sponsorship, and document scope covering the four cryptographic assets, HSM, and core banking platform.
prerequisites: Executive approval of programme charter
Budget allocation confirmation for USD 250,000 first phase

migration_steps.activity: Perform comprehensive cryptographic inventory and data classification: catalogue all RSA-2048 TLS certificates, ECDSA P-256 API signing keys, RSA-3072 key-wrapping keys, and ECDH P-256 channels; map data sensitivity and retention periods (10-15 years) to each asset.
prerequisites: Access to certificate management systems, HSM key inventory, and application configuration repositories
Data classification policy and records retention schedule

migration_steps.activity: Conduct harvest-now-decrypt-later (HNDL) risk assessment: identify which assets protect data with confidentiality lifetimes of 10-15 years, quantify exposure, and rank assets by HNDL risk priority.
prerequisites: Completed cryptographic inventory (step 2)
Threat intelligence on quantum computing timelines and HNDL adversary capabilities

migration_steps.activity: Engage Thales in writing to obtain confirmed PQC support status for Luna Network HSM 7: ML-KEM and ML-DSA algorithm support, required firmware version, FIPS 140-3 certification status, production availability date, and upgrade path.
prerequisites: Defined technical requirements for ML-KEM and ML-DSA in HSM
Non-disclosure agreement if required by vendor

migration_steps.activity: Engage core banking platform vendor in writing to obtain PQC compatibility roadmap, supported algorithms (ML-KEM for key establishment, ML-DSA for signatures), required platform versions, and migration timeline.
prerequisites: Defined interface and cryptographic dependency requirements for core banking platform
Contractual review of vendor support obligations

migration_steps.activity: Develop target PQC architecture and migration design: define hybrid modes (classical + ML-KEM for key establishment, classical + ML-DSA for signatures), crypto-agility requirements, and fallback strategies for assets where vendor support is unconfirmed.
prerequisites: Completed HNDL risk assessment (step 3)
Vendor engagement responses or documented non-responses (steps 4 and 5)

migration_steps.activity: Procure non-production PQC laboratory environment: software-based PQC libraries (e.g., OpenSSL 3.x with ML-KEM/ML-DSA), test HSM if vendor provides evaluation units, and isolated test network for interoperability testing.
prerequisites: Approved procurement request within budget
Vendor confirmation of evaluation unit availability (if applicable)

migration_steps.activity: Conduct laboratory testing of ML-KEM for key establishment and ML-DSA for digital signatures: validate hybrid TLS handshakes, API authentication signatures, key-wrapping workflows, and ECDH replacement scenarios in non-production environment.
prerequisites: Procured laboratory environment (step 7)
Target architecture design (step 6)
Written confirmation of HSM PQC capabilities or software fallback approved

migration_steps.activity: Develop detailed migration runbooks, rollback procedures, and operational readiness plan for production PQC changes, including change management approvals and regulatory notification requirements.
prerequisites: Successful laboratory testing results (step 8)
Regulatory review of PQC migration obligations

migration_steps.activity: Execute production crypto change for highest-priority HNDL-exposed asset: migrate RSA-3072 key wrapping to hybrid ML-KEM key encapsulation for database encryption keys, subject to HSM vendor confirmation and operational approval.
prerequisites: Written HSM vendor confirmation of ML-KEM production support and firmware compatibility (step 4)
Successful laboratory validation of ML-KEM key wrapping (step 8)
Completed runbooks and rollback procedures (step 9)
Change advisory board approval
Scheduled within permitted production change window before 2026-12-01

migration_steps.activity: Execute production crypto change for ECDH P-256 internal secure channels: migrate to hybrid ML-KEM key establishment, subject to HSM vendor confirmation and operational approval.
prerequisites: Written HSM vendor confirmation of ML-KEM production support (step 4)
Successful laboratory validation of ML-KEM key establishment (step 8)
Completed runbooks and rollback procedures (step 9)
Change advisory board approval
Scheduled within permitted production change window before 2026-12-01

migration_steps.activity: Execute production crypto change for ECDSA P-256 internal API authentication: migrate to hybrid ML-DSA digital signatures, subject to HSM vendor confirmation and operational approval.
prerequisites: Written HSM vendor confirmation of ML-DSA production support (step 4)
Successful laboratory validation of ML-DSA signatures (step 8)
Completed runbooks and rollback procedures (step 9)
Change advisory board approval
Scheduled within permitted production change window before 2026-12-01

migration_steps.activity: Execute production crypto change for RSA-2048 TLS certificates: migrate customer-facing TLS to hybrid ML-KEM key establishment and ML-DSA certificates, subject to HSM vendor confirmation, core banking vendor confirmation, and operational approval.
prerequisites: Written HSM vendor confirmation of ML-KEM and ML-DSA production support (step 4)
Written core banking vendor confirmation of PQC compatibility (step 5)
Successful laboratory validation of hybrid TLS (step 8)
Completed runbooks and rollback procedures (step 9)
Change advisory board approval
Scheduled within permitted production change window before 2026-12-01

migration_steps.activity: During change freeze: continue non-production laboratory testing, vendor engagement follow-ups, documentation updates, and planning for phase 2. No production cryptographic changes, HSM firmware upgrades, or major application deployments.
prerequisites: Internal policy confirmation that non-production laboratory activities are permitted during freeze
No production impact from laboratory activities

migration_steps.activity: Post-freeze: complete any deferred production migrations, conduct post-implementation review, update risk register, and plan phase 2 for remaining assets and full PQC transition.
prerequisites: Change freeze lifted (after 2027-01-15)
Completion of phase 1 production changes or documented deferrals
Vendor confirmations for any deferred items

blockers.blocker: Thales has not confirmed production support, firmware compatibility, or delivery timeline for ML-KEM and ML-DSA on Luna Network HSM 7.
blockers.reason: Without written confirmation, production migration of any HSM-dependent cryptographic operation (key wrapping, key establishment, signing) cannot be validated or approved. The HSM is the root of trust for RSA-3072 key wrapping, ECDH P-256 channels, and ECDSA P-256 signatures.
blockers.resolution_required: Obtain written confirmation from Thales of: (1) ML-KEM and ML-DSA algorithm support in Luna HSM 7, (2) required firmware version and FIPS 140-3 certification status, (3) production availability date, (4) upgrade path and compatibility matrix, (5) support statement for hybrid modes.

blockers.blocker: Core banking platform vendor has not provided written confirmation of PQC compatibility or a migration roadmap.
blockers.reason: The core banking platform likely terminates or originates TLS connections and may perform cryptographic operations. Without vendor confirmation, migration of RSA-2048 TLS certificates and any core-banking-dependent interfaces cannot proceed to production.
blockers.resolution_required: Obtain written confirmation from core banking vendor of: (1) PQC algorithm support (ML-KEM for key establishment, ML-DSA for signatures), (2) required platform version, (3) migration timeline, (4) compatibility with hybrid modes, (5) support obligations under existing contract.

blockers.blocker: Procurement of PQC-capable HSM firmware, evaluation units, and software libraries requires budget approval and vendor quotes that are not yet available.
blockers.reason: Laboratory testing and production migration depend on access to PQC-capable hardware and software. Without procurement, testing cannot validate interoperability.
blockers.resolution_required: Obtain vendor quotes, complete procurement approval within USD 250,000 budget, and secure delivery of evaluation units or software licenses.

blockers.blocker: Interoperability of hybrid ML-KEM/ML-DSA modes with existing TLS terminators, load balancers, and application frameworks is unvalidated.
blockers.reason: Production migration requires proven interoperability. Without laboratory validation, production changes risk service disruption.
blockers.resolution_required: Complete laboratory interoperability testing (step 8) and document results; obtain vendor compatibility statements for network and application infrastructure.

blockers.blocker: Regulatory notification and approval requirements for cryptographic algorithm changes are not fully documented.
blockers.reason: Banking regulators may require notification or approval before production cryptographic changes. Unclear requirements could delay or block production migration.
blockers.resolution_required: Engage compliance and legal teams to document regulatory obligations; obtain any required notifications or approvals before production changes.

blockers.blocker: Production change freeze from 2026-12-01 through 2027-01-15 prohibits production cryptographic changes, HSM firmware upgrades, and major application deployments.
blockers.reason: Any production migration not completed by 2026-11-27 must be deferred until after 2027-01-15, extending the exposure window.
blockers.resolution_required: Schedule all production changes before 2026-12-01 or plan for post-freeze execution; obtain change advisory board approval for pre-freeze window.

vendor_dependencies.evidence_required: Written statement confirming ML-KEM and ML-DSA algorithm support, required firmware version, FIPS 140-3 certification status, production availability date, upgrade path, and hybrid mode support.

Written confirmation of PQC compatibility roadmap, supported algorithms (ML-KEM for key establishment, ML-DSA for signatures), required platform version, migration timeline, and contractual support obligations.
